name: Nervous System Reset
description: Breath-led, floor-based and deliberately slow. Unwind the jaw and shoulders, and let your body remember what settled feels like.

name: Pilates
description: Precise mat pilates for posture, control and quiet core strength. Small movements, full attention.

name: Yoga
description: Foundational hatha — breath, alignment and simple, unhurried shapes. A steady place to begin, or to come back to.

name: Soft Flow
description: A vinyasa that moves like water. Slow transitions, long exhales, and no rush anywhere in the room.

name: Power Flow
description: Strong, rhythmic and warm. For the days you want to sweat, build heat and feel unmistakably alive.

name: Yin Yoga
description: Long, quiet holds that reach into connective tissue and the busy mind. The practice of staying.

name: Yin & Reiki
description: Yin shapes held while hands-on Reiki moves through the room. Deep rest with a gentle current underneath.

name: Sound Healing
description: Tibetan bowls, gongs, chimes and voice — a live soundscape that shifts your state and quiets the noise.

name: Sound Bath
description: Lie down, close your eyes and let the instruments do the work. An immersion in vibration and rest.

name: Cacao & Yoga Nidra
description: A warm cup of ceremonial cacao, then guided yoga nidra — sleep-adjacent rest that resets the whole system.

name: Parental Yoga
description: A soft, adaptable practice for parents and parents-to-be — room for your body, your breath and your season of life.
